headline: Portugal's Last Circus Elephant Finds Freedom at Europe's Sanctuary
meta_description: Julie, Portugal's last circus elephant, has arrived at Europe's first large-scale elephant sanctuary and is already enjoying her newfound freedom.
summary_short: After years in the circus, Julie—Portugal's last circus elephant—has arrived at Europe's first large-scale sanctuary and taken her first mud bath as a free animal.
body:
Julie, Portugal's last circus elephant, has arrived at Europe's first large-scale elephant sanctuary. She is already roaming free on the grounds, marking a turning point after her years performing in the circus ring.

The sanctuary represents a significant milestone for elephant welfare across the continent. Julie's arrival and immediate freedom to explore—including enjoying a mud bath—signals a new chapter for a life previously confined to circus performances. The establishment of Europe's first large-scale facility dedicated to housing elephants underscores growing momentum toward ending captive elephant use in entertainment.

Julie's transition from circus to sanctuary offers hope to advocates working toward better conditions for animals in captivity. Her ability to engage in natural behaviors like mud bathing from day one reflects the sanctuary's design prioritizing animal wellbeing and freedom.
